purpose: Mid-article dark conversion band, shared by blog-post and case-study

responsive.phone: Decorative art panel sits inline with the content stacked below it.
responsive.tablet: Content switches to items-center alignment with a 60px horizontal gutter (tablet:px-[60px]); decorative art becomes absolutely positioned with a portrait aspect ratio (tablet:aspect-[1420/3144]) and no rotation (tablet:rotate-0); heading steps to tablet:text-h3-t; content max-width narrows to 70% (tablet:max-w-[70%]).
responsive.desktop: Content switches to a row layout (desktop:flex-row desktop:items-center) with the art anchored to the left edge (desktop:left-[-83px]); content max-width widens to 85% (desktop:max-w-[85%]); outer padding widens (desktop:px-40).
